title: Conquest of the Northern Kings

questions.question: Who was the leader of the northern coalition?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:1 (ESV): "When Jabin, king of Hazor, heard of this..."

questions.question: How numerous was the army gathered against Israel?
options: Like the sand that is on the seashore
questions.correctAnswer: Like the sand that is on the seashore
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:4 (ESV): "...a great horde, in number like the sand that is on the seashore..."

questions.question: What did God tell Joshua to do to their horses and chariots?
options: Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire
questions.correctAnswer: Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:6 (ESV): "...you shall hamstring their horses and burn their chariots with fire."

questions.question: Which northern city did Joshua burn?
Did Joshua leave anything undone of what the Lord commanded Moses?
options: He left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses
questions.correctAnswer: He left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:15 (ESV): "...he left nothing undone of all that the Lord had commanded Moses."

questions.question: Where was the battle fought against the northern kings?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:5 (ESV): "...they came and encamped together at the waters of Merom to fight against Israel."

questions.question: Why did the kings come out to fight?
options: It was the Lord's doing to harden their hearts that they should come against Israel
questions.correctAnswer: It was the Lord's doing to harden their hearts that they should come against Israel
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:20 (ESV): "For it was the Lord's doing to harden their hearts that they should come against Israel in battle..."

questions.question: Who were the Anakim?
options: Gigantic people cut off from the hill country
questions.correctAnswer: Gigantic people cut off from the hill country
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:21 (ESV): "And Joshua came at that time and cut off the Anakim from the hill country..."

questions.question: Which cities of the Anakim were left?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:22 (ESV): "There was none of the Anakim left... only in Gaza, in Gath, and in Ashdod did some remain."

questions.question: What was Hazor formerly?
options: The head of all those kingdoms
questions.correctAnswer: The head of all those kingdoms
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:10 (ESV): "...for Hazor formerly was the head of all those kingdoms."

questions.question: How long did Joshua make war with all those kings?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:18 (ESV): "Joshua made war a long time with all those kings."

questions.question: Did Israel burn any cities that stood on mounds?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:13 (ESV): "But none of the cities that stood on mounds did Israel burn, except Hazor only..."

questions.question: What did the Israelites generally do with the spoil of these cities?
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:14 (ESV): "And all the spoil of these cities and the livestock, the people of Israel took for their plunder..."

questions.question: Did any city make peace with Israel?
options: None except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon
questions.correctAnswer: None except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:19 (ESV): "There was not a city that made peace with the people of Israel except the Hivites, the inhabitants of Gibeon..."

questions.question: What was the final result of the war described in the last verse?
options: And the land had rest from war
questions.correctAnswer: And the land had rest from war
questions.explanation: Joshua 11:23 (ESV): "...And the land had rest from war."

key_verse_text: So Joshua took the whole land, according to all that the LORD had spoken to Moses. And Joshua gave it for an inheritance to Israel according to their tribal allotments. And the land had rest from war. (ESV)
